package.name: auv_dvl
package.description: Driver for the Teledyne Wayfinder DVL, using Teledyne's own official Python driver directly (confirmed working via a standalone Windows/VM test -- see auv_dvl/README.md for that test's notes), wrapped in a minimal ROS2 node. Publishes velocity as nav_msgs/Odometry on /dvl/odometry, matching the odom0 placeholder already stubbed (commented out) in auv_localization/config/ekf.yaml.
